revision.text: The FAQ says guests may bring two unfrozen, commercially sealed non-alcoholic drinks in plastic bottles, up to 33.8 fl oz each; canned water is prohibited. Confirm the event’s limit because the separate Rules page gives a different quantity.
revision.previous_prepared_text: Guests may bring two unfrozen, commercially sealed non-alcoholic drinks in plastic bottles, up to 33.8 fl oz each; canned water is prohibited.

taft-theatre: The Rules page permits up to four unfrozen, commercially sealed non-alcoholic drinks in plastic bottles, up to 33.8 fl oz each, and prohibits canned beverages. It asks visitors to check the event page to see whether drinks must be poured on the day. Confirm the event-specific limit.

Commercially-sealed non-alcoholic beverages in plastic bottles, cannot be frozen. Up to four 33.8 fl oz bottles per patron. Please check the event page of your show to check if these beverages need to be poured on the day of show. Canned beverages are prohibited.
